title: WordCount job stopped making progress
description: A WordCount MapReduce job stopped making progress, and its application master log grew to around 100,000 lines.

groundTruth.cause: The node running the job's application master was disconnected from the network, so it repeatedly failed to contact the ResourceManager and could not renew its HDFS lease.
goodNextSteps: Check network connectivity from the application master's node to the ResourceManager and NameNode
Check the ResourceManager for the node's status (lost or unhealthy NodeManager)

notes: Loghub Hadoop run with an injected network disconnection. About 100,000 lines (8 MB): far too large to paste into a model's context, so it tests whether the app's compression adds value.
